# Game Data Packs (LFS) Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the three game-data git submodules with LFS-tracked prebuilt packs (`data/`), generated by an in-workspace cargo bin that fetches upstream data via pinned-SHA partial clones.

**Architecture:** A `game-data-pack` bin crate fetches the five upstream repos (sparse, pinned SHAs from `data/manifest.toml`), runs the existing CSV→rkyv pipeline plus a new lossy-q85 icon pipeline, and writes `data/xiv-db/{lang}.rkyv` + `data/icons/images.tar.zst`. `xiv-gen-db` and `ultros-xiv-icons` switch from build-script generation to `include_bytes!` of the LFS files, with a build-script guard that fails loudly on un-smudged LFS pointers. The submodules are then deleted; classjob-icons' used files are vendored.

**Tech Stack:** git LFS, git partial clone (`--filter=blob:none` + sparse-checkout), rkyv 0.7.42 + flate2 (container unchanged in this PR — the zstd swap is PR 3), `image` 0.25 + `webp` 0.3 (lossy q85), tar + zstd 0.13 for the icon archive, toml/serde for the manifest.

### Task 2: LFS pointer guard shared check

**Files:**
- Create: `game-data-pack/src/lfs_guard.rs` — but consumed as source-include by build scripts, so put the function in a tiny file both can `include!`: create `data/lfs_guard.rs` instead (plain function, no crate):

```rust
/// Errors when `path` contains a git-lfs pointer stub instead of real data.
/// Build scripts include! this file. Kept dependency-free.
pub fn assert_not_lfs_pointer(path: &std::path::Path) {
    let mut head = [0u8; 42];
    use std::io::Read;
    let n = std::fs::File::open(path)
        .and_then(|mut f| f.read(&mut head))
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("cannot read {}: {e}", path.display()));
    if head[..n].starts_with(b"version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec") {
        panic!(
            "{} is a git-lfs pointer, not the real file. Run: git lfs install && git lfs pull",
            path.display()
        );
    }
}
```

- Test: `game-data-pack/src/main.rs` — `mod lfs_guard { include!("../../data/lfs_guard.rs"); }` plus a `#[cfg(test)]` test writing a fake pointer file to a tempdir and asserting the panic message via `std::panic::catch_unwind`, and a real-bytes file that passes.

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `assert_not_lfs_pointer(&Path)` — Tasks 5 and 6 `include!` `data/lfs_guard.rs` from build scripts via `include!(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../data/lfs_guard.rs"))` (adjust `../` depth per crate).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Manifest::load/save` (Task 1), `xiv_gen::csv_to_rkyv::read_data_from` (this task).
- Produces: CLI `cargo run -p game-data-pack -- [--pinned|--latest] [--offline-source <path-to-populated-checkout>] [--skip-icons]`. Writes `data/xiv-db/{en,ja,de,fr,cn,ko,tc}.rkyv` and `data/icons/images.tar.zst`, prints a summary (per-lang item counts, pack sizes, item ids with no icon file upstream).

Key implementation notes (complete enough to write from):

- `fetch.rs::fetch_source(cache_root, name, source, sparse_paths) -> PathBuf`: cache dir `dirs`-free — use `{cache_root}/{name}`; if `.git` absent: `git init`, `git remote add origin {url}`. Then `git fetch --depth=1 --filter=blob:none origin {sha}` + `git sparse-checkout init --no-cone` + write patterns + `git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD`. Validated 2026-07-30: 1.2s fetch, 6s checkout for 5 CSVs. `universalis-assets` uses pattern `/icon2x/` (full dir, ~500MB first time). Cache root default: `{repo_root}/.game-data-cache/` (gitignore it) so it's per-machine reusable.
- Layout assembly: fetch `ffxiv-datamining` first with patterns `/csv/{en,ja,de,fr}/{Sheet}.csv` for the 31 sheets (`const SHEETS: [&str; 31]` — copy the list from `read_data`'s calls: Item, Recipe, ClassJob, ClassJobCategory, BaseParam, SpecialShop, Leve, LeveRewardItem, LeveRewardItemGroup, ENpcBase, ENpcResident, GilShop, GilShopItem, TopicSelect, PreHandler, ItemSearchCategory, ItemUICategory, ItemSortCategory, CompanyCraftSequence, CompanyCraftPart, CompanyCraftProcess, CompanyCraftSupplyItem, CompanyCraftDraftCategory, CompanyCraftType, CompanyCraftDraft, RetainerTask, RetainerTaskNormal, RecipeLevelTable, CollectablesShopItem, CollectablesShopRewardScrip, CraftLeve). Then fetch cn/tc into `{datamining}/csv/cn` and `{datamining}/csv/tc` with patterns `/{Sheet}.csv`, and ko into `{datamining}/csv/ko` with patterns `/csv/{Sheet}.csv` (ko nests one deeper — its own layout). Nested git checkouts inside another checkout's working dir are fine (that is what submodules are).
- `--offline-source <path>`: skip all fetching; use `{path}/xiv-gen/ffxiv-datamining` and `{path}/ultros-frontend/ultros-xiv-icons/universalis-assets` directly. Used for the initial generation from the already-populated main checkout.
- `--latest`: for each source `git ls-remote {url} {branch|HEAD}` → update `sha` in manifest, save, then proceed as `--pinned`.
- `db.rs`: for each of the 7 `Language`s: `read_data_from(datamining_root, lang)` → `rkyv::to_bytes::<_, 1_048_576>` → flate2 `Compress::new(Compression::best(), true)` + `compress_vec(..., FlushCompress::Full)` — copy the exact code from `xiv-gen-db/build.rs` (it is deleted in Task 5; this crate becomes its only home) → write `data/xiv-db/{lang}.rkyv`.
- `icons.rs`: port `resize_all_images`/`compress` from `ultros-frontend/ultros-xiv-icons/build.rs` (deleted in Task 5), with two changes: use `rayon` `par_iter` instead of tokio (build-script-era tokio not needed in a bin), and encode with `webp::Encoder::from_rgba(rgba.as_raw(), w, h).encode(85.0)` instead of `image::ImageFormat::WebP`. Keep: 60/40/25 px `CatmullRom` resize, `{file_stem}_{Large|Medium|Small}.webp` names inside the tar (match `IconSize` Display), tar → `zstd::Encoder::new(_, 19)` → `data/icons/images.tar.zst`.
- Missing-icons summary: after reading `en` data, list `items` whose `icon` column value has no `{item.key_id}.png`… note the icons are keyed by **item id filename** (`10.png`, `18355.png`) — compare against item key ids present in `icon2x/`, print count + first 20 ids.

### Task 7: CI, Docker, auto-update workflow

**Files:**
- Modify: `.github/workflows/rust.yml`, `.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml`, `.github/workflows/glitchtip-upload-test.yml` — replace `submodules: recursive` with `lfs: true` in every `actions/checkout` block.
- Rewrite: `.github/workflows/update_game_data.yml`:

```yaml
name: Update Game Data
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  update-game-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: nightly-2026-01-06
      - name: Regenerate packs against latest upstream
        id: gen
        run: |
          cargo run --release -p game-data-pack -- --latest | tee gen-summary.txt
          if git diff --quiet data/; then
            echo "has_updates=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_updates=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
      - name: Verify consumers build against new packs
        if: steps.gen.outputs.has_updates == 'true'
        run: cargo check -p xiv-gen-db -p ultros-xiv-icons
      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.gen.outputs.has_updates == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update game data packs"
          title: "chore: update game data packs"
          body-path: gen-summary.txt
          branch: update-game-data
          delete-branch: true
          base: main
      - name: Add generation summary to job summary
        if: always()
        run: cat gen-summary.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
```

(Also fixes the previous version's stale `base: master`.)
